text:
alex: quick q — noticed some responses include both global and per-route rate headers after the edge/proxy chain. how should clients reconcile when they disagree? e.g. global shows 120 remaining, route shows 0.

maya: good callout. we currently emit the historical X-RateLimit-* headers (global-oriented). route buckets are a newer concept and we started adding separate fields in a few places.

juan: behavior today: if route bucket is exhausted the request will 429 regardless of global. headers sometimes reflect different scopes because they come from different layers.

daria: proposal: keep the existing X-RateLimit-* names as-is for backward compat (global semantics), and add explicit routed headers with an "X-RI-" prefix so clients can opt-in to route-aware logic. e.g.

```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 120         # legacy/global (no change)
X-RI-Global-Remaining: 120        # explicit global
X-RI-Route-Remaining: 0           # route-level bucket
X-RI-Quota-Bucket-Id: route_abc123
```

alex: fine but we must avoid breaking older SDKs that only read X-RateLimit-Remaining. switching that to be route-level would be a breaking change.

maya: agreed — don't change existing header meanings in-place. docs + SDK guidance should be the first-class signal. default client behavior should be conservative: compute effective_remaining = min(global, route) when both are present.

juan: quick pseudo:
```
# prefer explicit RI headers, fall back to legacy X-RateLimit-*
global = headers.get("X-RI-Global-Remaining") or headers.get("X-RateLimit-Remaining")
route = headers.get("X-RI-Route-Remaining")
if global is None and route is None:
    effective = None  # treat as unknown/unlimited per client policy
else:
    effective = min(filter_present_ints([global, route]))
```

daria: also add `X-RI-Quota-Bucket-Id` so clients can correlate logs and retries to a specific bucket (useful for debugging spikes). include the usual Retry-After on 429s.

sre-bot: FYI deploy-canary: headers-change-additions scheduled 2024-07-12T03:00:00Z to canary cluster.

alex: ok. action items: maya open PR for header names + docs, add SDK note to prefer min, and ensure 429 body contains bucket id and human hint. tagging @juan for API review.

maya: will do — PR later today. @juan PTAL when you have a minute. :+1:

juan: ack, I'll review tomorrow morning.

alex: thanks all. one more: should we have a migration note for customers to avoid surprises?

maya: yes — include a short breaking-change note that we are adding X-RI-* headers but not changing X-RateLimit-* semantics. recommend SDKs to implement min logic.

juan: if we later decide to flip meanings we'll do it in a major version and announce.

alex: perfect. closing this thread unless new objections. :white_check_mark:
